items.problem: Bootstrap omitted linked project inputs and copied incompatible legacy assembly metadata.
items.evidence: lessons.json dev_agent_struggles[0]; Geolocation.csproj linked Page/Compile/Content items; session-log missing-XAML build cascade.
items.root_cause: Physical directory recursion is not an evaluated MSBuild project inventory.
items.change: Resolve common MSBuild properties, copy linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content items to Link paths, and skip AssemblyInfo.cs.
items.expected_effect: Shared XAML/assets arrive in the target automatically, avoiding reconstruction and duplicate assembly attributes.
items.falsifiable_check: On a Geolocation rerun, bootstrap copies MainPage.xaml, all eight scenario XAML files, and shared assets while no legacy AssemblyInfo.cs exists.

items.problem: The scaffold manifest was overwritten and invalid UWP background-task declarations passed validation.
items.evidence: migration-score candidate_launch_status and discrepancies.json: 0x80080204 prevented launch and failed all eight features.
items.root_cause: The skill treated a copied TaskEntryPoint extension as sufficient without a packaged activatable WinRT/COM class.
items.change: Preserve the scaffold manifest, store the UWP manifest as reference, mark manifest adaptation explicitly, validate $targetentrypoint$ and ActivatableClassId, and correct the background-task patterns.
items.expected_effect: Invalid desktop activation shapes fail before launch with an actionable fix, while the scaffold's valid desktop package structure remains intact.
items.falsifiable_check: A rerun no longer reaches 0x80080204; before launch, validator either passes a supported activation shape or reports each missing activatable class.

items.problem: The documented build loop invoked a nonexistent command.
items.evidence: session-log turn 19: winapp rejected the build subcommand.
items.root_cause: Build and launch responsibilities were assigned to the wrong CLI.
items.change: Replace winapp build with dotnet build throughout the migration workflow.
items.expected_effect: The first prescribed build command works in the supported environment.
items.falsifiable_check: A rerun performs the first compile with dotnet build and has no unrecognized winapp build error.
